author: Danielle R.
content: Wore this to a beach wedding in Florida and got asked about it all night. The blue floral print is richer in person than in the photos, and the smocked waist meant I didn't need to worry about the fit changing after dinner.

author: Megan Alvarez
content: The adjustable straps are what sell this for me. I'm 5'2" and usually have to get maxi dresses hemmed, but I could shorten the straps enough that it sits right at my ankle. Lightweight enough for August without being see-through.

author: Priya N.
content: Packed this for a week in Portugal and it was the only thing I re-wore. Barely creased coming out of the suitcase, and it works with sandals in the day and heels at night.

author: Chloe Bennett
content: Lovely dress and the tiered hem moves beautifully. Only reason it's four stars is the bust runs a little generous on me, so I'm wearing it with a strapless bra rather than going without.

author: Sarah Whitfield
content: Third Grace Karin dress I've bought and the quality is consistent. The ruching across the bust is forgiving without looking bulky, which is rare in this price range.

author: Aisha Karim
content: Comfortable and cool in real heat, which was my main test. Fabric is thinner than I expected but that's the point in 35 degrees. Would buy the black colourway too.

author: Jennifer Cole
content: Bought the medium in blue floral and it fits exactly as the size chart says. Great value for something I'll wear all summer.

author: Bethany Ross
content: Really pretty and true to the listing photos. Docking one star because the inner lining is short, so I'd wear a slip with it in bright sun.

author: Nicole Tran
content: Print and cut are nice but the smocking at the back stretched out after a couple of wears. Still wearable, just less structured than when it arrived.

author: Hannah Frost
content: Sizing was the issue for me. I'm normally a medium and this was tight across the shoulders while being loose at the waist. Returning for a large rather than keeping it.
